method: R1 blind suread (subagent read text only, no md/rules)

facts.fact: After the call Hattie sits on a rock wrapped in a blanket and watches the sun rise from the ocean.
facts.anchor: Hattie watches the sun rise from the ocean.

facts.fact: After the call ended she sat for a time before the fire with a cup of tea, then went outside with her blanket to wait for dawn.
facts.anchor: she sat for a time before the fire with a cup of tea

facts.fact: The late-night calls started a little over six months after she moved to the cove, first as hangups from an unrecognized number.
facts.anchor: They’d started a little over six months after she’d moved to the cove—hangups at first by a number she didn’t recognize

facts.fact: She knew for sure it was Tommy calling after Paige McMahon’s death and the text a week later reading “Help me stop.”
facts.anchor: She knew for sure it was Tommy calling after the death of Paige McMahon and the subsequent text a week later.

facts.fact: Paige McMahon was Tommy’s only known victim since his escape eight years prior — twenty-seven years old, killed in her sleep with the base of her skull pierced by a thin pointed object (Bedfellow MO).
facts.anchor: Paige McMahon was Tommy’s only known victim since his escape eight years prior.

facts.fact: In the end she reached out to Detective Ramsby, who at the time was still in charge of Tommy’s case.
facts.anchor: In the end she’d reached out to Detective Ramsby, who at the time was still in charge of Tommy’s case.

facts.fact: Ramsby got back to her a week later saying the number was a burner phone bought with cash at a roadside market in Delaware.
facts.anchor: He’d gotten back to her a week later saying the number was registered to a burner phone that had been purchased with cash at a roadside market in Delaware.

facts.fact: Ramsby said they used cell towers to locate the text’s origin near a hotel complex in North Carolina.
facts.anchor: We did use cell towers to locate where the text originated from—it was near a hotel complex in North Carolina

facts.fact: She withheld one thing from Ramsby: once when the phone rang she said only “Tommy?” and heard a surprised inhale then a click as the call ended, which confirmed it for her.
facts.anchor: There had been a surprised inhale, then a click as the call ended.
